headline: Public hearings on a ferry terminal at 10 Blaney Street, a car wash on Highland Avenue, and 53 affordable homes on Margin Street.
summary: The agenda includes many development projects, such as new housing, a car wash, a ferry terminal, and a hotel renovation. It also includes a recommendation on a zoning change for roof-mounted wind and the 2027 meeting schedule.
items: A. 57 Wharf Street Units UCB and UCC, and 201 Derby Street: applicant requests continuation to December 3, 2026. Proposes demolishing the second floor, third floor, attic, and roof to add 3 floors with 18 new dwelling units.

B. 440 Highland Avenue: applicant requests continuation to November 19, 2026. Proposes interior renovation of vacant plaza storefronts to move the Spark program Depot from the existing Walmart. No footprint changes.

C. 11 Summer Street, 5-9 Summer Street, and 15 Summer Street (The Salem Inn): applicant requests continuation to November 19, 2026. Proposes renovating the 3-story building at 11 Summer Street into a 16-unit hotel, with parking changes, garage renovations, landscaping, and solar car ports.
D. 10 Blaney Street: public hearing. Proposes a new ferry terminal building with site improvements.

E. 56 Margin Street, 54 Margin Street, 7 High Street, 20 Endicott Street, and 24 Endicott Street: continuation of public hearing. Proposes a 22,806 square foot building with 53 affordable homes, a shelter with 70 beds, and supportive programming space. Thirteen parking spaces.

F. 370-376 Highland Avenue, 378-380 Highland Avenue, and 382 Highland Avenue: continuation of public hearing. Proposes demolishing two buildings, including Puleo's Dairy and a storage facility, to build a 4,400 square foot car wash. 24 parking spaces, 22 used as vacuum stations.
G. 6 Technology Way: endorsement of a plan believed not to require approval under the Subdivision Control Law (ANR).
H. 54, 56, and 58 Swampscott Road: public hearing. Proposes a 6,625 square foot building for food manufacturing and office use, with an ancillary restaurant use. 31 parking spaces and landscaping.

I. 16 Bridge Street: public hearing. Proposes a two-family dwelling with two dwelling units and four on-site parking spaces. Requests relief from Bridge Street Neck Overlay District development standards.
J. 160 Federal Street: public hearing. Proposes amending a June 1, 2020 decision for changes to landscaping, paving, parking locations, transformer location, and mechanical enclosure.
K. 5 Willson Road, 7 Willson Road, and 9 Willson Road: endorsement of a plan believed not to require approval under the Subdivision Control Law (ANR).
Recommendation to City Council on a zoning amendment relating to sections 6.9, 3.1, 4.1, and 10 to include roof mounted wind.
Review and approval of the 2027 Planning Board meeting schedule.

Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
  
 
 
 
 
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Salem Planning Board will be held on  
Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. via remote participation in accordance with Section 
30A of Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021, as amended by Section 40 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 
2023, and further amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025. 
 
Kirt Rieder, Chair 
 
 
Important Announcement: 
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings 
in real time, via technological means. In the event that we are unable to do so on matters 
not requiring a public hearing, we will post on the City of Salem’s website  an audio or 
video recording, transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings as soon as 
possible after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely in the meeting via a remote participation platform 
called Zoom. Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to 
attend this meeting may access the remote participation meeting through any one of the 
following ways: 
 
Watching the Public Meeting: 
• Go to the website link: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87460376527?pwd=R3ZHWW9wM3k3QXRtSTAzWWdP
WVF6dz09 or 
• Go to the website link www.zoom.us/join and enter meeting ID # 874 6037 6527, 
followed by meeting password 999036, if directed to do so on screen, or 
• Dial toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted enter meeting ID #  
874 6037 6527, followed by meeting password 999036 if directed. Those dialing in 
only will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting, but can follow along 
with the project materials available for download at this link 
(https://cityofsalem1.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/PlanningBoard/Eiex2VK4lulDiqWrUC8UoC
YBv2pwr4dBfkRaaUILXEgnog?e=AKzvGG) or 
• Watch the meeting live on Salem Access Television Channel 22. 
 
 
 
 
CITY OF SALEM 
PLANNING BOARD
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 5, 2026 
Page 2 of 6 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting: 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments 
during the portion of the hearing designated for each agenda item. Members of the public 
will be asked to use the virtual “Raise Hand” function in Zoom to indicate that they would 
like to provide comment.  
• Dial *9 on your phone’s dial pad to raise your hand if you are using the toll-free 
phone number. 
• Click the “raise hand” button if you are using the Zoom application on your computer 
or phone. 
 
For each agenda item, the moderator will identify attendees with raised hands by their 
screenname or the last 3 digits of their telephone number and will then unmute them. The 
moderator will then request that the attendee unmute their device to provide their full 
name and address if they would like it included in the record and comment for the record. 
The moderator will ensure all public comments are subject to the same time limit. 
 
The moderator will go down the list of attendees with their hands raised in the order 
presented by the Zoom application.  The attendee list is ordered in the order that 
participants raise their hands. 
 
Providing Public Comment Before the Meeting: 
Members of the public can alternatively email their comment before the start of the meeting 
to: planningboardcomments@salem.com 
 
Familiarizing Yourself with Zoom 
We encourage members of the public to install and familiarize themselves with Zoom in 
advance of the meeting. 
 
If you plan on providing public comment and are logging into this meeting via the Zoom 
application, please test your speakers and microphone ahead of time. If we have trouble 
hearing you when you speak, we will move on to the next person and try to return to you 
later in the list. If this happens, we recommend that you call the toll-free number to access 
the meeting and provide your comment. 
 
Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign 
language interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a 
reasonable modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City of 
Salem ADA Coordinator as soon as possible and no less than 2 business days before the 
meeting, program, or event. 
 
The zoom meeting will open 15 minutes before the start of the meeting to allow participants 
to connect and practice with the audio and raise hand functions
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 5, 2026 
Page 3 of 6 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
MEETING AGENDA 
• Regular Agenda 
 
A. 57 Wharf Street Units UCB and UCC, and 201 Derby Street (Map 34, Lot 408)  
*This applicant requests to continue to December 3, 2026* 
Applicant: Christina Granese f/b/o Pickering Wharf Complex, LLC; Rockett Manag & 
Realty CO 
Description: A continuation of public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
of Christina Granese f/b/o Pickering Wharf Complex, LLC; Rockett Manag & Realty CO at 
57 Wharf Street Units UCB and UCC, and 201 Derby Street (Map 34, Lot 408) in the B5 
Central Development Zoning District, Flood Hazard Overlay District (FHOD) and Coastal 
Resilience Overlay District (C -ROD) for Site Plan Review and C -ROD Site Plan Review in 
accordance with sections 9.5 Site Plan Review and 8.9 Costal Resilience Overlay District 
of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to demolish the 
second floor, third floor, attic, and roof of the existing building to accommodate 3 new 
floors with a total of 18 new dwelling units. 
 
B. 440 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 4) 
*This applicant requests to continue to November 19, 2026* 
Applicant: Kinetic Design and Development f/b/o Walmart 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
of Kinetic Design & Development F/b/o Walmart located at 440 Highland Avenue (Map 3, 
Lot 4) in the Business Park Development District (BPD) and Entrance Corridor Overlay 
District (ECOD) for Site Plan Review and Business Park Development Special Permit in 
accordance with Section 9.5 Site Plan Review and Section 8.3 Business Park Development 
District of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to internally  
renovate and repair the vacant storefronts in the plaza to move their “Spark” program 
Depot from the existing Walmart. No changes to the building footprint are proposed. 
 
C. 11 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 459), 5-9 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 461), and 15 
Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 462) 
*This applicant requests to continue to November 19, 2026* 
Applicant: West House LLC, Emmerton House LLC, and Peabody House LLC, 
Description: A continuance of a public hearing for all persons interested in the 
application of West House LLC, Emmerton House LLC, and Peabody House LLC, all d/b/a 
The Salem Inn, located at 5,7,9 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 459), 11-13 Summer Street 
(Map 26, Lot 461), and 15 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 462) in the B5 – Central 
Development district and Urban Renewal Overlay for Site Plan Review in accordance 
with Section 9.5 of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes the 
renovation of the existing 3 story building at 11 Summer Street to accommodate a hotel 
with 16 units. The applicant is proposing site renovations including an increase of 
parking, through exterior parking changes, and renovations of the existing 2 story 
garage. Other site improvements include landscape improvements, and solar car ports.
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 5, 2026 
Page 4 of 6 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
D. 10 Blaney Street (Map 41, Lot 278) 
Applicant: Aaron Udy f/b/o the City of Salem 
Description: A public hearing for all persons interested in the application of Aaron Udy 
f/b/o the City of Salem located at 10 Blaney Street (Map 41, Lot 278) in the Industrial and 
Coastal Resilience Overlay District (C-ROD) for C-ROD Site Plan Review in accordance with 
Section 8.9 of the Salem Zoning Ordinance and a Stormwater Management Permit in 
accordance with Chapter 37 of the Salem Code of Ordinances.  Specifically, the applicant 
proposes to construct a new ferry terminal building with site improvements.  
 
E. 56 Margin Street, 54 Margin Street, 7 High Street, 20 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lot 597), 
24 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lot 595)  
Applicant: Harborlight Homes and Lifebridge North Shore 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
of Harborlight Homes and Lifebridge  North Shore at 56, 54 Margin Street, 20 Endicott 
Street, 7 High Street (Map 25, Lot 597) and 24 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lot 595) in the 
Residential Two -Family District (R2), Coastal Resilience Overlay District (C -ROD), Flood 
Hazard Overlay District (FHOD ), and Smart Growth Overlay District (SGOD) for Smart 
Growth Overlay Plan Review and Coastal Resilience Overlay Site Plan Review in 
accordance with the following sections of the Salem Zoning Ordinance: Section 7.4 Smart 
Growth Overlay District and Section 8.9 Coastal Resiliency Overlay District. Specifically, 
the applicant proposes the demolition of the buildings at 24 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lot 
595) and 56 Margin Street (Map 25, Lot 597), the adaptive reuse of 54 Margin Street (Map 
25, Lot 597), and the preservation of the façade of 20 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lot 597) 
to accommodate for a 22,806 square foot building comprised of 53 affordable homes, a 
shelter with 70 beds, and supportive programing space along with other site 
improvements. Thirteen parking spaces are proposed on site. 
 
F. 370 376 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 63) 378 380 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 64), 
382 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 65)  
Applicant: Joseph Correnti f/b/o GR Development LLC 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
Joseph Correnti f/b/o GR Development LLC for the property located at 370 376 Highland 
Avenue (Map 3, Lot 63) 378 380 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 64) and 382 Highland 
Avenue (Map 3, Lot 65) in the (B2) Business Highway and (ECOD) Entrance Corridor 
Overlay District zoning districts for Site Plan Review in accordance with Section 9.5 of the 
Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to demolish two existing 
buildings onsite, "Puleo's Dairy" and a storage facility, to construct a 4,400 s.f.  car wash 
facility. 24 onsite parking spaces are proposed, 22 of which will also be used as vacuum 
stations.  
G. 6 Technology Way (Map 7, Lot 79)  
Applicant: Jason A. Panos f/b/o 1 Technology Way Salem LLC  
Description: Endorsement of a Plan Believed to not require approval under the 
Subdivision Control Law (ANR).
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 5, 2026 
Page 5 of 6 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
H. 54 Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 65), 56 Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 64), 58 
Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 63) 
Applicant: David Potter 
Description: A public hearing for all persons interested in the application of David Potter 
located at 54 Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 65), 56 Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 64), 
58 Swampscott Road (Map 7, Lot 63) in the Business Park Development District for a 
Business Park Development Special Permit in accordance with Section 8.3 of the Salem 
Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to construct a 6,625 square foot 
building used for food manufacturing and a business, professional, medical, or dental 
office. In addition, the applicant has requested approval for an ancillary restaurant use 
to the food manufacturing business. 31 parking spaces and landscaping improvements 
are proposed.  
 
I. 16 Bridge Street, Salem, Massachusetts (Assessors Map 37, Lot 45) 
Applicant: Stephen P. Lovely, on behalf of Neviol Shukulli and Marsela Shukulli 
Description: A public hearing for all persons interested in the application of Stephen P. 
Lovely, on behalf of Neviol Shukulli and Marsela Shukulli located at 16 Bridge Street, 
Salem, Massachusetts (Assessors Map 37, Lot 45). The property is located within the 
Coastal Resiliency Overlay District (CROD), Flood Hazard Overlay District (FHOD), Bridge 
Street Neck Overlay District (BSN), Entrance Corridor Overlay District (ECOD), and 
Residential Two-Family (R2) zoning district. The Applicant seeks the following approvals 
pursuant to Sections 8.7 and 8.9 of the Salem Zoning Ordinance:  1. Bridge Street Neck 
Overlay District Site Plan Review; 2. Bridge Street Neck Overlay District Development 
Standard Waiver Special Permit; and 3. Coastal Resiliency Overlay District Site Plan 
Review. Specifically, the Applicant proposes to construct a new two-family residential 
dwelling containing two dwelling units, together with four on-site parking spaces and 
associated site improvements.  The application includes requests for relief from 
applicable Bridge Street Neck Overlay District development standards, as identified in 
the application materials submitted to the Planning Board.   
 
J. 160 Federal Street (Map 26, Lot 2) 
Applicant: North Shore Community Development Coalition 
Description: a public hearing for all persons interested in the application of North Shore 
Community Development Coalition located at 160 Federal Street (Map 26, Lot 2) in the 
Residential two-family (R2) district, Coastal Resiliency Overlay District (C-ROD), and 
Flood Hazard Overlay District (FHOD) for Site Plan Review and Municipal or Religious 
Reuse Special Permit in accordance with Section 9.5 and Section 6.11 of the Salem 
Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to amend the Site Plan Review, 
Municipal or Religious Reuse Special Permit, and Flood Hazard Overlay District Special 
Permit decision date stamped June 1, 2020 for changes related to landscaping and 
paving materials, parking locations, location of transformer and location, height, and 
size of mechanical enclosure.
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 5, 2026 
Page 6 of 6 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
K. 5 Willson Road (Map 14, Lot 307), 7 Willson Road (Map 14, Map 190), and 9 Willson 
Road (Map 14, Lot 191)  
Applicant: Ryan Carlucci f/b/o Pauline M. Bertini Trust, c/o Andrea Bertini 
Description: Endorsement of a Plan Believed to not require approval under the 
Subdivision Control Law (ANR).  
 
• Old/New Business 
A. Recommendation to City Council on Zoning Amendment relating to amending 
sections 6.9, 3.1, 4.1, and 10 to include roof mounted wind.  
B. Review and Approve 2027 Planning Board Meeting Schedule  
 
• Review and Approval of Minutes 
A. Draft minutes from 9/17/26 
B. Draft minutes from 10/15/26 
C. Draft minutes from 10/19/26 
 
• Adjournment
